name: Ji Chunlin
current_role: Co-founder and vice chairman, Kuang-Chi (光启) group (title per Wikipedia; current title not re-verified)
profile: Ji Chunlin (季春霖) is one of five PhD graduates of Duke and Oxford who founded Kuang-Chi in Shenzhen in 2010, a metamaterials and advanced-technology group led by Liu Ruopeng. He is listed as a vice chairman co-leading Kuang-Chi's state-level metamaterial electromagnetic modulation laboratory.
interesting_fact: Kuang-Chi was founded by five PhD students fresh from Duke and Oxford (Liu Ruopeng, Lin Luan, Ji Chunlin, Zhang Yangyang, Zhao Zhiya), and the founders remained its senior executives; it hosts China's first state key laboratory for metamaterial technology.
notes: Limited individual coverage found; best route is via Kuang-Chi corporate channels. Kuang-Chi Group was added to the US Entity List in Dec 2020 (context for a podcast host).

name: Paul A Friedman
current_role: Director, Madrigal Pharmaceuticals; Chair of the Board, Prelude Therapeutics
profile: Paul A. Friedman, M.D., was CEO of Madrigal Pharmaceuticals from July 2016 to September 2023 and remains on its board. Earlier he was CEO and director of Incyte (2001-2014) and held R&D leadership roles at DuPont Pharmaceuticals, DuPont-Merck and Merck Research Laboratories.
interesting_fact: He led Incyte as CEO from 2001 until retiring in 2014, then came back to run Madrigal for seven years.
deep_cut_fact: Before industry he was an Associate Professor of Medicine and Pharmacology at Harvard Medical School; he holds an A.B. in Biology from Princeton and an M.D. from Harvard.
notes: Best route is via Madrigal or Prelude Therapeutics corporate/IR channels.

name: Chen Suobin
current_role: Chairman, Qingdao Kingking Applied Chemistry Co. (青岛金王, 002094.SZ) and Qingdao Kingking Group
profile: Chen Suobin (陈索斌), born 1964 in Zhaoyuan, Shandong, quit his job in 1993 to found Qingdao Kingking Light Industrial Products, which grew into the candle-maker Qingdao Kingking. He has chaired the listed Qingdao Kingking Applied Chemistry since 1998 and still chairs it per 2026 reports.
interesting_fact: He studied economics at Peking University and earned a master's from UCLA before returning to start his business in 1993.
deep_cut_fact: In 2003 he received the national 'Achievement Award for Returned Overseas Students' and was named one of Shandong's Ten Outstanding Young People.
notes: Chairmanship confirmed by Oct 2026 report (https://m.rccaijing.com/news-7521829029898024830.html). Route via listed company's board secretary office.

name: Huang Ping
current_role: Vice Chairman and General Manager, Shenghe Resources Holding (盛和资源, 600392.SH)
profile: Huang Ping (黄平) is vice chairman and general manager of Shenghe Resources, a Chinese rare-earth group, and a major individual shareholder (about 5.49% per a 2024 pledge announcement). He acted as chairman between July and September 2024 after the previous chairman left, before Xie Bing was elected. In 2026 he presented the company's overseas project plans.
interesting_fact: He temporarily performed the chairman's duties of Shenghe Resources from July 2024 until a new chairman was elected in September 2024.
notes: Common name; identity tied via Shenghe Resources role. Current role per 2026 reports (https://stock.10jqka.com.cn/20260905/c679622411.shtml). No personal bio found. Rare earths relevant to energy/data-center supply chain angle.

name: Huang Changhua
current_role: Chairman, Shenzhen Kingsignal Technology (深圳金信诺高新技术, 300252.SZ) (per undated profile; not re-verified)
profile: Huang Changhua (黄昌华), born 1968, has chaired and run Shenzhen Kingsignal since 2002; the company makes RF coaxial cables and communications interconnect products. A chemical-engineering graduate of South China University of Technology with a Tsinghua EMBA, he worked at Zhuzhou Chemical Industry Group, Zhuhai Hansheng and Jiangsu Hengtong before Kingsignal.
interesting_fact: He led Kingsignal's participation in drafting international standards for RF coaxial cable.
deep_cut_fact: Before Kingsignal he worked at cable maker Jiangsu Hengtong Group and at Hunan's Zhuzhou Chemical Industry Group; he was named to the Shenzhen Nanshan District science bureau expert pool for 2008-2009.
notes: Bio source is a user-contributed profile site (maigoo); verify against Kingsignal annual report. Route via listed company's board secretary.

name: Chen Qinpeng
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Comix Group (齐心集团, 002301.SZ)
profile: Chen Qinpeng (陈钦鹏), born 1972, is the founder of Shenzhen-based Comix Group, a stationery and office-supplies maker, and has been its chairman since 2000; he is also its legal representative and general manager. He also chairs the Qixin holding companies.
interesting_fact: He is vice chairman of the China Stationery and Sporting Goods Association and honorary president of the Shenzhen Chaoshan Chamber of Commerce.
notes: Bio from financial data platform lixinger (page returned 403 on direct fetch; content via search snippet). Route via listed company's board secretary.

name: Fang Bingliang
current_role: Co-actual controller and shareholder, Zhejiang Orient Gene Biotech (东方生物, 688298.SH); resigned as vice chairman/director in Aug 2024
profile: Fang Bingliang (方炳良) is one of the actual controllers of Zhejiang Orient Gene Biotech (东方生物), a biotech company based in Anji, Zhejiang. He served as its vice chairman and director until resigning in August 2024 for personal reasons, while keeping 26.46 million shares and his actual-controller status.
interesting_fact: Orient Gene is a family-controlled company: its 2024 filing notes family ties among the chairman Fang Jianqiu, director/GM Fang Xiaoliang, and former vice chairman Fang Bingliang.
notes: Low public profile; route via Orient Gene board secretary office.

name: Xia Mingxian
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Chongqing Meixin (Group) Co. (per undated profile)
profile: Xia Mingxian (夏明宪), born 1953 in Chongqing, founded Meixin in 1989 as an anti-theft door factory and built it into a diversified group spanning doors, auto/motorcycle parts, eco building materials, real estate and tourism; he is called the 'godfather of the door industry'. Meixin formed a joint venture with US company Mason in 1998.
interesting_fact: Meixin's TV slogan '美心防盗门，安全到家' and sponsorships of the Women's Volleyball Grand Prix and China FA Cup gave rise to the saying 'North has Panpan, South has Meixin'.
deep_cut_fact: He was a steelmaker and then a shipping-company sailor; in 1988 he opened a small hardware shop on his days off, and in 1989 started making security doors in a rented, abandoned air-raid shelter. He later studied six months at GE's management development institute.
notes: Sources are brand-info sites (cnpp, maigoo); current status not confirmed by recent news.

name: Shi Xugang
current_role: Shareholder (former controlling shareholder and chairman), Hangzhou Zhongwei Electronics (中威电子, 300270.SZ); current board role not confirmed
profile: Shi Xugang (石旭刚) was controlling shareholder, actual controller and chairman of Hangzhou Zhongwei Electronics (OB Telecom Electronics), a Hangzhou video-surveillance/communications company. He stepped down as general manager in 2021 but remained chairman; later he sold down shares and, around late 2025, waived voting rights on his 7.90% stake as control passed to Fu Yingbo.
interesting_fact: After a change of control, he committed to waive voting rights on his 7.90% stake and not seek control of the company he had controlled.
notes: No personal bio found. Chairman-in-2021 per https://www.nbd.com.cn/articles/2021-08-27/1893140.html. Low profile; route via company board secretary.

name: Deng Yong
current_role: Chairman, Chongqing Zhengchuan Pharmaceutical Packaging Materials Co. (正川股份)
profile: Deng Yong (邓勇), born 1967, has spent his career in glass: he joined a glassware factory as a worker in 1985, ran several glass factories from 1988, and became general manager of Zhengchuan in 1997. He was chairman and GM of the listed company 2013-2022 and chairman since October 2022; it makes pharmaceutical glass tubing, vials and caps in Beibei, Chongqing.
interesting_fact: In July 2026 Zhengchuan signed a long-term strategic cooperation agreement with Italy's SPAMI on pharmaceutical packaging manufacturing and market expansion.
deep_cut_fact: He started at 18 as a factory-floor worker at a glassware plant in 1985, rising to workshop director and technician before running Tankou Glass Factory; he is a qualified engineer.
notes: Common name; identity tied via Zhengchuan role. Route via company board secretary.

name: Adam Koppel
current_role: Partner, Bain Capital Life Sciences; Director, Kailera Therapeutics
profile: Adam Koppel, MD, PhD, is a partner at Bain Capital Life Sciences and represents its lead investment on Kailera Therapeutics' board; Kailera raised a $400M Series A and later a $625M IPO. Earlier he led healthcare at Bain Capital Public Equity (2003-2014), was Biogen's EVP Corporate Development and Chief Strategy Officer (2014-2016), and worked at McKinsey.
interesting_fact: He holds an MD and a PhD in neuroscience from Penn, a Wharton MBA (Palmer Scholar), and an AB/AM in History and Science from Harvard.
deep_cut_fact: He chairs the Board of Trustees of the Boston Museum of Science and co-chairs the Harvard Medical School Discovery Council.
notes: Best route via Bain Capital Life Sciences. SEC holdings likely reflect Bain fund positions he is attributed with.

name: Yang Yongsong
current_role: Major shareholder (over 5%, non-executive) of Toyou Feiji Electronics (同有科技, 300302.SZ)
profile: Yang Yongsong (杨永松) is a 5%+ shareholder of Beijing-based data-storage company Toyou Feiji Electronics, holding about 7.4-8.4% in 2025. Company filings state he holds no position in the company, does not take part in daily operations, and is not the controlling shareholder; he has been gradually selling down shares since 2020.
interesting_fact: Toyou Feiji is a Chinese storage/IT company; his stake fell from 8.38% to about 7.38% during 2025 via announced sell-downs.
notes: Not an executive; no personal bio found. Data-storage link may be relevant to data-center theme. Do not confuse with the PLA general of the same name (d. 2022).

name: Shaji Mathew
current_role: EVP and Chief Human Resources Officer (Group Head of HR), Infosys
profile: Shaji Mathew has spent over 31 years at Infosys, rising from software engineer trainee to global head of delivery for Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare and Life Sciences, and became Group Head of HR in March 2023, succeeding Krish Shankar. He is an Infosys executive officer leading its AI-first workforce and capability-based talent model.
interesting_fact: He moved from leading delivery for Infosys' financial services and healthcare businesses directly into the top HR job in 2023.
deep_cut_fact: He began at Infosys as a software engineer trainee; he also serves on the board of IIIT Bangalore and the CII National Committee on Leadership and HR.
notes: IIIT-B board/CII roles per Infosys profile as shown in search results. Active speaker (WEF, SHRM, qwoted media source profile).

name: Song Qun
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Linklogis (联易融, 9959.HK)
profile: Song Qun (宋群), also known as Charles Song, founded Shenzhen supply-chain finance technology company Linklogis in February 2016 and took it public in Hong Kong on 9 April 2021. He is responsible for the group's overall strategy and management.
interesting_fact: Linklogis went from founding (Feb 2016) to a Hong Kong IPO (April 2021) in about five years.
deep_cut_fact: He studied at Huazhong University of Science & Technology and holds an MBA from the University of Melbourne; he also served as an independent non-executive director of UK-listed Ascential plc until early 2024.
notes: Sources are aggregator profiles; confirm titles via Linklogis HKEX filings / IR site.

name: Madhu Kapur
current_role: Public (non-promoter) shareholder of Yes Bank since 2020; no current executive role found
profile: Madhu Kapur is the widow of Ashok Kapur, who co-founded India's Yes Bank with Rana Kapoor; her wealth derived from the family's Yes Bank stake. In May 2020 the Madhu Kapur Group was reclassified from promoter to public shareholder of the bank, when it held about 1.1% directly.
interesting_fact: In 2015 the Bombay High Court ruled that Yes Bank's promoters must jointly nominate three directors to the board, a case brought by her family.
notes: Coverage is dominated by the 2014-2020 promoter dispute with Rana Kapoor (avoid in outreach). No recent news found; reclassification per https://www.businesstoday.in/sectors/banks/yes-bank-stake-madhu-kapur-group-gives-up-promoter-status-years-long-family-fight-ends/story/405456.html. Not a natural fit for an entrepreneurship/energy podcast.

profile: Huang Lihou (黄李厚) was one of nine individuals who in February 2015 signed agreements to acquire part of the 868.8 million listed shares that Shagang Group transferred in Jiangsu Shagang Co., the source of his steel-related wealth. No executive role or personal biography was found.
